title: Platform tool registry and chatbot labels: add list_datasets / query_dataset under service-ai (cloud registers them for the ask agent)
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Found by the cloud os-dev agent on objectstack-ai/cloud PR #4557 (card cloud#4551, epic cloud#3825). Out-of-scope finding, class b, with a named producer.

## What happens

`platform-tool-names.ts` says: "registering a new tool in a cloud AI package means adding its name here … A new name also needs its chatbot.tool.NAME label in every pack".

Cloud's `service-ai` now registers `list_datasets` and `query_dataset` for the in-product ask agent (PR #4557). Neither name appears in `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai']`, and neither has a `chatbot.tool.*` label. The chat therefore shows a raw tool name while the agent works.

## Change

1. Add both names under `service-ai` in the registry.
2. Add their `chatbot.tool.list_datasets` / `chatbot.tool.query_dataset` labels in every language pack (zh-CN: 「查看指标」/「按指标查询」 or similar).
3. Add the tests the registry already pins.

Seam: spec: `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai']` → runtime: cloud `service-ai` `registerDatasetTools`; ui: `plugin-chatbot` `toolLabels`.
